verdicts.reason: A keeps the 'Quiet Hours' book cover as the hero and works as a left-to-right banner. However, the cream card is crammed almost against the top and bottom canvas edges, and the fine print is as large as the body copy, so the hierarchy is flat. B drops the book cover entirely, losing the key imagery. Its Inkwell & Lantern logo shrinks to an illegible speck, and its legal text is too tiny to read, so B is less faithful to the original than A.
